description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms - Order made under Subsection (2) of Section 1, Judicature (Amendment) Act No. 34 of 2022
categorisation: This gazette content focuses on the implementation of legal provisions (Judicature (Amendment) Act, No. 34 of 2022) by appointing an operational date for Section 4 of the Act. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the primary purpose is legal/regulatory in nature - bringing a specific section of legislation into force. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with the operationalization of legal amendments rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
